notes.title: Update 19: Difficulty Settings Now Available
notes.content:
Dear Tycoons,


Update #19
[v0.1099]

[h2][b]Difficulty Levels are implemented.
Presets: [Easy] [Normal] [Hard][/b][/h2]

[h3]Starting Money: [40k] [20k] [10k][/h3]
It's how much money you want to start with.

[h3]Bankruptcy:  [OFF] [-10000] [-5000][/h3]
[-5000]: Your factory will go bankrupt when your balance drops to -5000.
[-10000]: Your factory will go bankrupt when your balance drops to -10000.
[OFF]:  Your factory will never go bankrupt.

[h3]Robot Level-up: [Fast] [Normal] [Slow][/h3]
If set to fast, your robots will level-up faster.

[h3]Factory Level-up: [Fast] [Normal] [Slow][/h3]
If set to fast, you will get more XP per product.

[h3]Market Difficulty: [Easy] [Normal] [Hard][/h3]
It affects market prices and special order time-limits.

[h3]Market Stability: [Stable] [Normal] [Unstable][/h3]
It affects price-difference between market-cycles.
If set to unstable, high price-changes may occur.

[h3]Robot Charge & Oil Capacity: [High] [Normal] [Low][/h3]
It affects the frequency of robots going to chargers and lubricators.
If set to high, robots go to chargers and lubricators less frequently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522850/905f3bd90b1d97c58a93441585207ab1bd1f257a.jpg[/img]

Please keep reporting if you see anything! 
Thanks so much for all the support!

notes.title: Small Update #18
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

[v0.1096]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522851/5a8270297d2ce1123a7ad803c14ca5e12504cb4f.jpg[/img]
- Tiles-visibility-design is changed (during garden-objects placement).
- Hover over info is added to Economy&Statistics.
(Calculation of machine maintenance and robot maintenance can be found on Economy&Statistics Section and Help-Economy Section)
- Tutorial update for sustainability (extra step for Sustainability)
 * Plant trees in your gardens to increase your sustainability (2 x Tree1)
 * (Purchase wind turbines and solar panels to reduce electricity costs and increase your sustainability)
 * (Machines, chargers, lubricators and robots decrease your sustainability.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522851/537a9d1ef8334336b5be5c9b9e8429bced67f552.jpg[/img]

- Tutorial update for Durability explanation
 * If you choose high durability raw-material, you'll get more XP but less profit.
 * If you want to earn more money, you should choose low durability levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522851/f4983722113676eaa980904a284fe6a6a4894308.jpg[/img]

- New shortcuts (Machines, Advanced Machines, Robots Room, Garden, Construction, Edit/Demolish Tool) are added to Options-Controls.
- Shortcuts are visible on HUD.
- Day-Night cycle is off by default.

Please keep reporting if you see anything! 
Thanks so much for all the support!

notes.title: Small Update #14
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

[v0.1077]

* After you execute a plan for any product, it'll be saved and you'll be able to use your plan for the next production of the same product.

* Machine placement has changed. Last approval-click is removed, and also multiple machine-placement is possible.

* Now robots are clickable. You can click on a robot to see its name, selected building, charge and oil.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522851/bea836602ba2b1fed61e59201fd606ddf781424d.jpg[/img]

* Robot name and color can be edited from My Robots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522851/f81b9f826efab3079d9230d6dc6d5c11f14aec27.jpg[/img]

* Weather Conditions and/or Day-Cycles can be turned off from the main-menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522851/f797046fc64b4bd67daca6eb448146af62e6ad7a.jpg[/img]

* Electricity and sustainability values can be seen by right-clicking on a machine, solar panel, wind turbine, tree and connector.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522851/48685d36b7f0037394a054360048eb8cba2bdc79.jpg[/img]

* Sustainability calculation can be seen when you hover on its symbol.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522851/02e43ee568c105c065f5af4a0b984a7e88cc68ca.jpg[/img]


* Price per unit can be seen on Special-Orders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522851/8c557d538ee5ff31b76db4558bdd966baf8bcbbd.jpg[/img]

* Tutorial is improved. Starting room-grid-recommendations are changed. Starting money amount is increased to 15k.
* Help-UI design improvements
* Track-Robot button is updated.
* UI designs are improved for Leaderboard-UI, Milestones-UI, My Robots-UI and Robots Market-UI design.
* Game-speed shortcuts are changed:
1-key for STOP
2-key for 1x speed
3-key for 3x speed
4-key for 5x speed
5-key for 10x speed

Please keep reporting if you see anything! 
Thanks so much for all the support!

notes.title: Small Update #5
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We received many complaints about the game being very similar to Little Big Workshop, this is true, we did inspire our game a lot on this great title. Please keep in mind you are playing just a prologue (extended demo) which is really a great beta test and source of massive feedback for the full release for us.

[v0.1053]
- Edge-Scroll Sensitivity feature now on OPTIONS-GAMEPLAY
- Camera Rotation (Mouse) Enabled/Disabled now on OPTIONS-GAMEPLAY
- BUG-fix: Delivery Truck stuck in the loading area (or called as Robot Stuck in the main storage)

Please keep reporting if you see anything! 
Thanks so much for all the support!
